patterns.note: Sections alternate between a light, airy hero with minimal content and dense, full-width content blocks on a dark background.
Extremely oversized, decorative serif typography is used as primary visual elements and section dividers, contrasting sharply with clean, modern sans-serif for body and functional text.
A high-contrast palette of deep purple and light peach/cream is used for large background areas, accented by a vibrant pink for calls to action and decorative text.

Large, decorative text elements ('Houses', 'World') are used as dramatic visual transitions, scrolling into and out of view as the user progresses down the page, acting as large, fixed-position overlays that scroll with the content.
The site uses a 'hero-to-feature-to-grid' structure, with a prominent hero, followed by a section highlighting key features, then a grid of locations, and finally product/newsletter signup.

technique_notes: The primary visual effect is achieved by using massive, decorative text elements as full-screen or near full-screen overlays that scroll with the page content, acting as dramatic visual anchors and transitions between content blocks. These elements are styled with a vibrant accent color against a contrasting background. Other content sections simply scroll into view without additional animation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative display headings (~8-10x body) with a high-contrast serif, paired with clean, modern sans-serif for main headings and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a soft but not fully rounded aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of grandeur, while content within cards and grids is balanced.

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the use of monumental, decorative serif typography as a primary visual element and a scrolling, full-screen transition between content sections. This gives the site a highly artistic, editorial, and almost sculptural quality, making the text itself a key part of the visual experience.
